title: bzf project file
description: The `<Name>.bzf` that opens a project: a one-line JSON object at the top of the project folder, whose file name is the project's name. Written when the project is created and again only when a copy becomes a project of its own. Every store format has `format` and `project`; this schema describes the rest for the store format bzf/1.x. A reader opens a project of a newer major format read-only, never refuses it and never rewrites it.

format.description: The store format: "bzf/" and the format's version, "bzf/1". A higher minor version only adds what a reader keeps without knowing it.

project.description: The project's id: random at creation, kept when the folder is moved, new when it is copied.

copiedFrom.description: The id of the project this one was copied from.
